title: Micromouse x Mars Rover Hardware Workshop
content:
The "Build Your Own Space Control System" workshop hosted with McMaster Mars Rover was nothing less than a huge success! 

We took a trip into the future and were tasked with a critical mission - With the clock ticking, restore the monitoring and navigation system of a Mars reconnaissance rover.

Participants learned about ESP32, various sensors, and other electronic components in order to take on the challenge of designing and assembling an electronic system capable of detecting obstacles, assessing its surrounding, and responding to its environment.

Couldn't attend the workshop? Not to worry! Slides and instructions are posted on our discord server if you'd like to try it at home. 

Coming up: Micromouse team registration and kit purchasing now available!

title: Micromouse hosts its first workshop
content: Thank you SO MUCH for such a warm welcome at our very first meeting!! Look out for more upcoming workshops + a post on competition logistics/resources. We covered robot chassis design, sensor selection, and microcontrollers for autonomous navigation. Slides and resources are now available on our Discord server!

title: Welcome to McMaster Micromouse 2026-2027
content: We're thrilled to kick off an exciting new year of Micromouse! Whether you're in first year or graduating, in electrical, software, mechatronics, or mechanical engineering, there's a place for you on our teams. Stay tuned for our workshop schedule, club showcase booth, and competition announcements.
